title: Project Four
discipline: One discipline, for example Editorial & Publication Design
format: Size, materials and quantity, for example Poster, 18 × 24 in, screen print
summary: One sentence that says what this is and why it matters. Many reviewers read only this.
tools: The software you used, for example InDesign, Illustrator
role: Your part of the work. Group projects only, so name exactly what you did.
coverAlt: Your strongest image of the finished work. On the Works page it is cropped to 4:3.

blocks.caption: Final video. Paste a Vimeo or YouTube link in url.

blocks.heading: The brief
blocks.body: What were you asked to do? One or two sentences.

blocks.heading: The idea
blocks.body:
What insight shaped your answer? This is the most important paragraph on the page, so make it specific.

A second short paragraph can explain why the idea fits the brief.

blocks.label: Research. What you collected, read, photographed or visited.

blocks.heading: Process
blocks.body: How did the idea develop? Name one direction you rejected, and why. Reviewers learn the most about you here.

blocks.caption: Sketches and iterations, in the order they happened.
The finished work in context. A photo of the real object, or a convincing mockup.
A detail. A close-up that rewards a second look.

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: What worked, and what would you do differently? Two or three sentences.
